build_lmdb_from_tsv: build an LMDB database from TSV feature files containing image bounding box features and class probabilities
create_lmdb_env: create an LMDB environment with a large map size for storing pickled vision feature records
read_tsv_with_dictreader: read a TSV file using csv.DictReader with custom fieldnames for vision feature data
pickle_put_lmdb_txn: pickle and store vision feature records into an LMDB transaction by image ID
store_keys_list_lmdb: store a list of all image ID keys in LMDB for fast iteration and lookup
